title: liquiditybot · Liquid Glass
description: Apple Liquid Glass command board (v9). Curated to the ~22 panels a trading desk scans, top-down by decision urgency: vitals -> money -> risk heat -> the book -> execution -> model. Semantic-only color (Apple system palette). Beautiful natively on any Grafana Cloud; for the full frosted-glass DOM restyle, install the signed 'Business Text' panel (marcusolsson-dynamictext-panel) and move the CSS from the hidden injector tile into its afterRender JS (Cloud sanitizes native <style>). See docs/grafana/README_glass.md.
